post.summary: Multi-identifier land record search with scorer & ambiguous top-2 detection
post.description:
Multi-identifier search using exact normalized matching and trigram similarity.
Calculates candidate match score and generates human-readable reasons.
If the score difference between top 2 candidates is < 0.10, flags `ambiguous=True`.
Never auto-confirms ownership.

get.summary: Get Accuracy and Reliability Lab evaluation benchmark runs
get.description:
Reads evaluation benchmark run reports from eval_runs/ directory.
Provides field-separated CER, FEA, critical field FEA, silent error rates,
digit confusion matrix, and evaluated release gates from gates.yaml.

post.summary: Run live evaluation pipeline benchmark (Tech Admin action)

post.summary: Analyze scan quality before submission

get.summary: Get risk & conflict alerts for parcel with reason_bn and evidence
get.description:
Returns verified risk and conflict alerts for the specified parcel.
Bangla wording strictly follows 'সম্ভাব্য অসঙ্গতি, যাচাই প্রয়োজন'.
Every alert is accompanied by explainable reason_bn and evidence.

schema.title: Response Get Parcel Alerts Api V1 Parcels  Parcel Id  Alerts Get

post.summary: Execute risk & conflict rules engine idempotently (Reviewer/Supervisor/Tech Admin)
post.description:
Executes rules R1 to R6 on the parcel context in an idempotent, deduplicated manner.
RBAC: Enforced strictly for Reviewer, Supervisor, and Tech Admin. Denied for Citizens.
Never overwrites or deletes reviewed or dismissed alert history.

patch.summary: Update alert status to reviewed or dismissed with reviewer note
patch.description:
Updates an alert's status to 'reviewed' or 'dismissed' with an explanatory note.
RBAC: Enforced strictly for Reviewer+. Denied for Citizens.
Keeps review history in evidence chain and records a cryptographic audit log.

post.summary: Generate comprehensive buyer parcel summary report (Citizen allowed for demo parcels only)
post.description:
Generates a 6-section buyer parcel summary report.
Citizens are restricted to generating reports for synthetic demo parcels only.
Officers (Reviewer, Supervisor, Tech Admin) may generate for any parcel.
Persists to `buyer_reports` and logs cryptographic audit trail.

get.summary: Get buyer risk report JSON (Citizens see only their own reports)
get.description:
Retrieves full buyer report in JSON format.
Enforces isolation: Citizens see only reports they created.

get.summary: Render printable HTML for buyer risk report (Citizens see only their own reports)
get.description:
Renders styled, printable HTML with print media queries for server-side PDF or browser printing.
Enforces isolation: Citizens see only reports they created.
